name: GET_FIRMWARE_REV
note: u32 = bytes a.b.c.d (a in bits 31:24). PowerSDR requires 2.1.4.8 .. 2.1.255.255; 0 means 'radio not answering yet'.

name: INITIALIZE
note: Sent once at start-up. Firmware effect unknown from source.

name: GET_SERIAL_NUM
note: u32: byte0, byte1 as two decimal digits each, then (>>16) as 4 digits: 'bb' 'bb' - 'wwww'.

name: GET_MODEL
note: 0 = FLEX-5000A, 1 = 5000C, 2 = other 5000 variant, 3 = FLEX-3000.

name: READ_TRX_EEPROM_UINT32
note: d1 = byte offset. Same opcode is read as float by ReadTRXEEPROMFloat. See analysis/startup-and-eeprom.md.

name: WRITE_TRX_EEPROM_UINT32
note: WRITES CALIBRATION MEMORY. Blocked by firesidectl.

name: SET_MUX
note: Audio input mux (factory LLHW form only); normal input selection is done via codec regs 0x13-0x16.

name: READ_CODEC_REG
note: d1 = register; used to read-modify-write reg 0x07 output mutes.

name: WRITE_CODEC_REG
note: d1 = codec register, d2 = value. 5000 register map: inputs 0x13 FlexWire/DB9, 0x14 line-in RCA, 0x15 balanced TRS ('Phono'), 0x16 mic: value = signed gain (negative as 0x100+v), 0x80 = muted. Output volumes = 0xFF - slider: 0x0A/0x0B headphone L/R(?), 0x0C/0x0D ext speaker, 0x0E line-out RCA, 0x0F int speaker (5000C). Output enables are bits in reg 0x07 (bit set = muted): 0x80 int spkr, 0x30 ext spkr, 0x0C headphone, 0x40 line-out; 0xFC mutes all.

name: SET_RX1_FREQ
note: d1 = f_MHz float32 (plain version; PowerSDR uses the _TW form in normal operation).

name: SET_TRX_PREAMP
note: 0/1. PowerSDR forces 0 at start.

name: SET_TEST
note: 0/1 test-path relay (with SET_GEN and SET_SIG: the generator into the receiver; PowerSDR's transmit loopback calibrations also use it). Page 6.

name: SET_GEN
note: 0/1 built-in signal generator. With SET_TEST 1 and SET_SIG 1 (full duplex on) it is the receiver input, at the transmit DDS frequency, about -24 dBm. Page 6.

name: SET_SIG
note: 0/1 signal generator relay: the receiver input comes from the test path instead of the antenna. Built-in generator: page 6.

name: SET_QSD
note: Calibration only (Quadrature Sampling Detector enable).

name: SET_QSE
note: Calibration only (Quadrature Sampling Exciter enable).

name: SET_INT_SPKR
note: 0/1 internal speaker amp (5000C only); also clear its mute bit in codec reg 0x07.

name: READ_PTT
note: Returns the same bitmap as the EVENT register: bit0 dot, bit1 dash, bit2 RCA PTT, bit3 mic PTT.

name: SET_HEADPHONE
note: 0/1 headphone amp; also codec reg 0x07 bits 0x0C.

name: SET_RCA_TX1
note: Rear RCA TX1 key line.

name: READ_PA_ADC
note: d1 = ADC channel; PA forward/reverse power etc. (also available via MIDI note 1).

name: SET_RX1_LOOP
note: 0/1: route selected antenna to RX1 OUT, with RX1 IN as the return (external preamp/filter loop).

name: SET_TR
note: 0/1 T/R relay. Used only in calibration routines.

name: SET_RX1_ANT
note: 0 N/C, 1 ANT1, 2 ANT2, 3 ANT3, 4 RX1 IN, 5 RX2 IN, 6 RX1 TAP, 7 SIG GEN, 8 VHF, 9 UHF. RX1 valid choices in the UI: ANT1 (default), ANT2, ANT3, RX1 IN, N/C.

name: SET_TX_ANT
note: 1..3 = ANT1..ANT3 (do NOT change while transmitting; manual warns it can damage the radio).

name: SET_PA_BIAS
note: PA bias. NEVER set blindly: wrong bias can destroy the PA. Calibrated per band in the PA bias table (EEPROM 0x2C0).

name: SET_MOX
note: 0/1 key/unkey the transmitter. DANGEROUS-gated; needs a correct antenna/dummy load.

name: ATU_SEND_CMD
note: d1 = (cmd<<8)|arg1, d2 = arg2. cmd: 1/2 inductor up/down, 3/4 cap up/down, 5 memory tune, 6 FULL TUNE (transmits), 8/9 Hi/Lo-Z, 10/11 antenna, 40 all-update, 41 version, 44 standby, 45 active, 46 store, 50-56 SWR threshold.

name: ATU_GET_RESULT
note: d1 = timeout ms. Returns 4 bytes: cmd, b2, b3, b4 where b4 = bytes still queued; poll with timeout 0 until b4 == 0 (FlushBuffer). Responses: 1 inductor, 2 capacitor, 3 Hi/Lo-Z, 4 antenna, FWD/REV power = ((b2<<8)+b3)*0.01, SWR from b3, tune pass/fail, version, standby/active.

name: SET_FULL_DUPLEX
note: 0/1 full duplex (TX during RX path). On, the transmit DDS (SET_TX_FREQ_TW) runs while receive stays on its own frequency: the built-in generator sits there (page 6).

name: SET_AMP_TX1
note: Keying line AMP RLY TX1 (rear panel) on/off with T/R; also *_DELAY_ENABLE / *_DELAY (ms) for sequencing.

name: SET_XVTR_ACTIVE
note: Transverter active.

name: SET_XVTR_SPLIT
note: Transverter split.

name: SET_RX1_DSP_MODE
note: Tells firmware the demod mode. enum DSPMode: 0 LSB, 1 USB, 2 DSB, 3 CWL, 4 CWU, 5 FM, 6 AM, 7 DIGU, 8 SPEC, 9 DIGL, 10 SAM, 11 DRM

name: SET_RX2_ANT
note: 0 N/C, 1 ANT1, 2 ANT2, 3 ANT3, 4 RX1 IN, 5 RX2 IN, 6 RX1 TAP, 7 SIG GEN, 8 VHF, 9 UHF. RX2 valid choices: N/C, RX2 IN, RX1 TAP (default), ANT1 (not on early HRFIO ASSY 27).

name: SET_RX2_ON
note: RX2 board on (only if fitted).

name: SET_STANDBY
note: 0 = powered up/operating, 1 = standby.

name: SET_IAMBIC
note: 0/1 iambic keying flag (keyer itself runs in PC software, FlexCW.dll).

name: SET_BREAK_IN
note: 0/1 CW break-in (QSK) in radio.

name: SET_EEPROM_WC
note: EEPROM write-control line. Never use outside factory calibration.

name: SET_RX_ATTN
note: 0/1 receive attenuator (FLEX-3000 path calls it at init; 5000 uses SET_ATT_*/preamp per band).

name: SET_FAN_PWM
note: Fan PWM duty.

name: SET_FAN_SPEED
note: Fan speed.

name: SET_RX1_FREQ_TW
note: d1 = DDS tuning word u32 = (uint)(0xFFFFFFFF * f_MHz / 500.0); d2 = f_MHz as float32. This is what PowerSDR sends. The float lets firmware choose band filters.

name: SET_RX2_FREQ_TW
note: As SET_RX1_FREQ_TW for RX2 (only if RX2 fitted).

name: SET_TX_FREQ_TW
note: As SET_RX1_FREQ_TW for the transmit DDS. Transmit-related: dangerous-gated.

name: GET_REGION
note: enum FRSRegion: 0 US, 1 Spain_UK, 2 Europe, 3 UK_Plus, 4 Italy, 5 Norway, 6 Denmark, 7 Latvia, 8 Slovakia, 9 Bulgaria, 10 Greece, 11 Hungary, 12 Netherlands, 13 France, 14 Russia, 15 Sweden, 16 Region_3, 17 Japan, 18 Italy_Plus. Out-of-range is treated as US.

name: SET_TX_DSP_MODE
note: enum DSPMode: 0 LSB, 1 USB, 2 DSB, 3 CWL, 4 CWU, 5 FM, 6 AM, 7 DIGU, 8 SPEC, 9 DIGL, 10 SAM, 11 DRM (radio uses it for transmit frequency limits).

name: SET_CW_PITCH
note: u32 Hz.

name: GET_STATUS
note: non-zero = 'extended' capabilities unlocked`).
